lessons.title: Surah Al-Fatihah (The Opening)
lessons.content:
بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

The opening chapter recited in every rak'ah of prayer. Contains 7 verses summarizing the Quran's message.
lessons.arabicText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّٰهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

lessons.title: Surah Al-Baqarah: Ayatul Kursi
lessons.content:
ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ

The Throne Verse describing Allah's supreme authority and knowledge.
lessons.arabicText: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ

lessons.title: Surah Yasin (Heart of Quran)
lessons.content:
يس وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

Called the 'heart of Quran' with profound messages about resurrection.
lessons.arabicText: يس وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
